articles.summary: Indian Railways is developing an indigenous signalling protocol for high-speed rail called the Bharat Train Control System (BTCS). The system is being designed specifically for Indian operating conditions.

articles.title: ITR filing deadline extension: Is July 31, 2026 the last date to file income tax return? Check latest developments
articles.summary: A belated return can still be filed within nine months from the end of the relevant tax year. For the 2025-26 tax year, this means the return can be submitted by December 31, 2026.

articles.summary: The Trump administration is considering a $100,000 fee for international students' work permits. This proposed charge would impact the Optional Practical Training program significantly. US universities and tech firms could face substantial repercussions from this policy change.

articles.title: Mileage drop due to E20? 2-6%, says 1 minister, 3-5%, says another
articles.summary: Government ministries have offered varied figures regarding fuel efficiency changes. Older vehicles using E20 fuel may see a slight mileage reduction. The Road Transport Ministry cited a 2-6% potential decrease in efficiency.

articles.title: NTT Data Payments to take UPI global
articles.summary: NTT Data Payment Services is developing a hub-based architecture for cross-border retail payments. This strategy aims to connect India's UPI with other Asian fast payment systems. The company's Adaptis brand unifies its digital payment suite across various markets.

articles.title: Tata Steel ends 25-year joint-venture with German company Martrade
articles.summary: Tata Steel is acquiring Martrade's stake in their joint shipping venture for Rs 335 crore. This move ends a twenty-five-year partnership with the German logistics group. The company also committed Rs 33,873 crore for capacity expansion at Neelachal Ispat Nigam.

articles.title: Zepto delays listing, looks to raise Rs 1,000 crore in funding
articles.summary: Zepto is seeking Rs 1,000 crore in pre-IPO funding, delaying its public listing plans. The quick commerce startup is targeting a valuation of $4-4.5 billion for this investment round. This valuation is over 30% lower than its previous $7 billion valuation.

articles.title: NSE settles pending Sebi cases for nearly Rs 1,500 crore
articles.summary: The National Stock Exchange has settled past regulatory lapses with Sebi for Rs 1,491 crore. This settlement resolves issues related to co-location and dark-fibre cases involving former officials.

articles.title: Flipkart, Amazon mount fee war as race heats up
articles.summary: Amazon and Flipkart are reducing seller fees to attract more businesses. This strategy aims to boost sales volumes in smaller Indian cities and towns. Lower costs for sellers translate into more affordable products for consumers.

articles.title: AI labs proving why IT companies still matter: Infosys CEO Salil Parekh
articles.summary: Salil Parekh led Infosys to double revenue and secure significant large deals. He focused on disciplined execution and a stable company culture. Infosys sees AI services as a substantial long-term growth opportunity.

articles.title: Formal retail credit access doubles over past decade
articles.summary: Formal retail credit penetration in India more than doubled over the past decade. Consumption-led lending, including personal loans, drove this significant growth. Credit access expanded to younger borrowers and women across India.

articles.title: Transponders switched off: How tankers with Saudi oil for India are exiting Red Sea by going ‘dark’
articles.summary: Following the Houthi attacks on several Saudi tankers, Indian refiners have increasingly opted to purchase Middle Eastern crude on a delivered basis.
